clients.name: Demo — Cedar Studio
clients.access: Arrange access with the office manager.

estimates.title: [Demo] Replace kitchen faucet
estimates.description: Remove the leaking kitchen faucet, install the customer-selected replacement, reconnect supplies and check for leaks. Dispose of the old faucet.

estimates.title: [Demo] Monthly office cleaning
estimates.description: Four evening visits: clean reception and work areas, vacuum floors, sanitize the kitchenette and restroom, and empty waste bins. Cleaning supplies included.

estimates.title: [Demo] Garden gravel delivery
estimates.description: Deliver two loads of washed gravel to the marked driveway area. Spreading and excavation are excluded. Confirm access before delivery.

estimates.title: [Demo] Product photography session
estimates.description: Photograph twelve products on a neutral background. Include basic color correction and twelve finished digital images. Additional retouching requires approval.
